name: early-economy
goal: Gather 200 food, 200 wood, 100 gold and 200 stone, train 21 villagers, build a lumber camp and a mill, and advance to the Feudal Age
note: AoE2 wiki "Early Economy (Age of Empires II)": gold in 8, silver in 10, bronze in 13 minutes

name: fast-castle-age
goal: Train 27 villagers, build 5 houses and advance to the Castle Age
note: AoE2 wiki "Fast Castle Age": gold in 14, silver in 17, bronze in 20 minutes

name: booming
goal: Train 100 villagers and advance to the Imperial Age
note: AoE2 wiki "Booming (Age of Empires II)": gold in 10, silver in 13, bronze in 18 minutes

name: rushing-the-enemy
note: AoE2 wiki "Rushing the Enemy": gold in 5, silver in 7, bronze in 10 minutes; the enemy Zhu Di (Chinese, player 2) has a town center, two lumber camps, a mill and a mining camp at exposed gold mines, no stone (the page gives no unit count)

name: defending-against-a-rush
goal: Advance to the Castle Age and survive the enemy attacks
note: AoE2 wiki "Defending Against A Rush": gold in 8, silver in 11, bronze in 15 minutes; the enemy Belisarius (Byzantines, player 2) attacks mostly with scout cavalry and men-at-arms (the page gives no wave times: the waves are a choice)

name: land-battle
note: AoE2 wiki "Land Battle (Age of Empires II)": gold 0 units lost, silver less than 6, bronze less than 11; the page names the army (Archers, Skirmishers, Men-at-Arms, Spearmen, Scout Cavalry, Feudal Age) and the last wave (Spearmen and Skirmishers), but no counts and no other wave: the counts and waves 1 to 5 are own

name: destroying-a-castle
note: AoE2 wiki "Destroying a Castle": gold in 7, silver in 9, bronze in 15 minutes; the start army and the defenders: the wiki lists no units ("Expand section"), so a Castle Age siege army and a Saracen guard

name: naval-battle
note: AoE2 wiki "Naval Battle (Age of Empires II)": gold less than 5 ships lost, silver less than 14, bronze less than 20

name: battle-formations
goal: Defeat all enemy units and lose few units
note: AoE2 wiki "Battle Formations": gold 0 units lost, silver less than 3, bronze less than 10; the page names the enemy types (Long Swordsmen, Pikemen, Elite Skirmishers, Mangonels, Scorpions) but no counts and no army of the player: the counts are own
